findings.rationale: Accepted: with review_station=panel the station fan-out uses performFinalPanel's budget rule (wall remaining, else the sealed pocket with budget_source: pocket) because it is the only panel that runs; budget_source on the station ledger row; two routing cases (pocket completes; neither suffices → final_panel_below_minimum); the §3 out-of-scope clause removed.
Accepted: a snapshot without review_station resolves to single; its digest is checked over the fields present (never re-digested); state-suite case with a 2-B fixture snapshot.

Accepted: --stdin-paths is newline-delimited; names containing LF or CR go through the per-file hasher, the rest through one batched process, results compared in tracked-file order so the first-mismatch text matches base; fixture gains a newline-bearing name.

Accepted: when two seats report the same finding_id with different digests the station qualifies both ids by seat index (s<i>.<id>); identical reports keep one unqualified id as today; unresolved_findings/findings_snapshot carry the qualified ids; routing case parks on panel findings and resumes with dispositions keyed by them.
Accepted: the runner case counts buildReviewPacket invocations (exactly one) and hashPacketDir calls (N) separately; the shared-vs-per-seat hash equality stays.
Accepted: evidence files (base/head suite records, timing, red-<suite>.txt) are depth-0 artefacts committed outside the campaign, as in 2-A/2-B; stated in §4.
Accepted as practice: at implementation depth-0 saves one red-<suite>.txt per new case in the evidence dir with the exact base assertion message (§4 sentence).
